integrity: Analytic proof and 33 auxiliary numerical assertions; no independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: The sign-crossing and nondegenerate alternative CLT are proved for fixed Gamma shapes 2<k<=5/2, fixed positive scale and the source's inverse-moment fitted-scale signed statistic. The root weights are small and are not among the source's emphasized numerical values. No assertion for data-selected weights, supremum test, finite-sample power, or fully exhaustive historical priority.
title: A unique blind tuning curve for a signed Lévy goodness-of-fit statistic under Gamma alternatives
